description: This file defines a utility function 'getPlaintextFontSize' that maps an 'EditorFontSize' value to a specific CSS class string based on the device screen type (desktop, tablet, mobile). It imports utility functions to detect screen type and a type definition for font sizes.

methods.name: getPlaintextFontSize
methods.description: Returns a CSS class string based on font size key and current device screen type.
